title: CNC Machinist/Programmer
location: Plant 1 - 801 Division St. Sioux City, IA
summary: Set up, operate, and modify CNC mill programs for contract manufacturing work.

detail.description: The CNC Machinist/Programmer sets up, operates, and modifies programs on CNC mills for the Contract Manufacturing division. Duties include optimizing programs and cutting techniques, setting up machines, editing programs and offsets, changing tooling and work holding, building fixtures, performing preventive maintenance, and maintaining a neat work area.
requiredExperience: Experience with vertical machining centers, slant bed turning centers, manual knee mills, and manual lathes.
Ability to hold tolerances to .001 inch.
Experience with micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, edge finders, gauges, presses, surface grinders, hand tools, and band saws.
MIG and TIG welding experience.
otherRequirements: High school diploma and/or vocational technical training.
Mechanical aptitude, problem-solving skills, basic math skills, and strong attention to detail.
CAD and CAM experience and general computer knowledge.
Ability to read and interpret GD&T and prints or drawings.
Ability to use overhead cranes and forklifts to move materials.
Fanuc and Haas control knowledge preferred.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and a safety-minded approach.

title: Manager - Contract Mfg
location: Plant 1 - 801 Division St. Sioux City, IA
summary: Coordinate contract manufacturing partners, supplier performance, quality, cost, and capacity.

detail.description: The Contract Manufacturing Manager manages and optimizes relationships with external metal fabrication and processing partners. The role oversees contract negotiation, supplier performance, cost control, and capacity planning while supporting technical specifications, safety standards, and applicable industry requirements. This manager works with engineering, quality, supply chain, and sales teams to resolve quality or delivery issues and drive continuous improvement across the metals supply base.

otherRequirements: Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
